## Lane conventions that bite (the short list; AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md are binding)

- Claim = assign **plus** a claim comment with session ID + branch; re-read comments before coding (shared GitHub identity).
- Merge queue: **flip draft→ready BEFORE arming** auto-merge; arming an already-green PR can silently fail to enqueue — after arming, watch `git log origin/main` (never the API) and re-enable on timeout.
- `pull_request_read get_check_runs` snapshots can be **~60 min stale**; run-level conclusions via `list_workflow_runs` are authoritative. Shell `curl` to api.github.com 403s and reads as a silent false-green — MCP tools only.
- Never `git stash` (shared stack across worktrees); worktree-first before any edit; repo-root `pnpm exec vitest run` only; build the dependency closure **with the package itself in the filter** before judging types; GitHub's sanitizer eats `<`+letter — space generics and read bodies back after posting.
- Every ruling this seat made is recorded on the issue it governs, with the measurement that justified it — the per-issue comments are the real handoff.
